spec.name: Projects and proposals
spec.purpose: Sarai develops the design proposal of each project from the creative direction Alejandra set: one card per project with its phase, creative direction, approval state and the documents attached, and the hand-off that sends a proposal into the consistency check.
layout: Grid of project Cards: client, location, KeyValue with phase / creative direction / approval / due date / budget
Drawer: project detail, summary, its documents in a DataTable, send-to-check button, Placeholder to request creative direction
logic: Send to consistency check writes projects.approval = in-check; it is only offered for draft or changes-requested, and only with design.develop.
Creative direction is read-only for the studio: it is Alejandra’s call, so requesting it is a Placeholder.
Filters are client-side over the live projects table; the drawer reads the documents of the selected project.

actions.label: Request creative direction
actions.intent: ask Alejandra for the creative direction of {project}
